name: dai-cg-priv
command: exec > /out/cg-dai-cg-priv.txt 2>&1; echo '== mount =='; mount | grep cgroup; echo; echo '== mountinfo =='; grep cgroup /proc/self/mountinfo | head -2; echo; echo '== caps =='; grep Cap /proc/self/status; echo; echo '== mkdir test =='; (mkdir /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-p && echo MKDIR_OK) || echo MKDIR_FAIL; (echo '+cpu +memory +pids' > /sys/fs/cgroup/dai-p/cgroup.subtree_control && echo SUBCTL_OK) || echo SUBCTL_FAIL; echo done
